page_title: SHU 1-0 BRE | Sheffield Utd v Brentford 09/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+2' Wesley Foderingham (Sheffield Utd) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
90+2' This is an obvious ploy to delay the restart of play from Wesley Foderingham (Sheffield Utd).
90+1' Jack Robinson (Sheffield Utd) will miss the next game.
90+1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jack Robinson (Sheffield Utd) was quite harsh and Stuart Attwell didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
89' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Wesley Foderingham intercepts the ball.
88' Ben Mee (Brentford) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
88' The resulting corner from Saman Ghoddos (Brentford) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
86' Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) receives a pass from Jack Robinson and goes for glory with an effort from distance, but the ball curls well wide of the right post.
84' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) displayed very unsporting behaviour.
82' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Stuart Attwell had an easy-decision to make.
82' Anis Slimane (Sheffield Utd) get himself out of a tight corner inside the box then shoots. The keeper leaps for the ball but it flies just wide of the right post.
81' Substitution. James McAtee leaves the pitch and is replaced by Sydie Peck (Sheffield Utd).
80' Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Mark Flekken stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.

80' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) was in a good shooting position inside the six-yard box and produced a first-time shot towards the top of the net, but the goalkeeper made an astonishing save to thwart him.
78' The attendance for today's match is 28509.
76' Total attempts – 6:8. The shots on goal statistics – 3:3.
73' We are about to witness a subsitution. Max Lowe (Sheffield Utd) for Andre Brooks.
71' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
70' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) swings in a cross from the corner, but Mark Flekken reads it well and gathers the ball.
68' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) latches on to a cross inside the box and heads the ball towards the right post, but it's an easy save for the keeper.
68' Michael Olakigbe (Brentford) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
66' Thomas Frank has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Michael Olakigbe (Brentford) replacing Keane Lewis-Potter.
65' It will be a substitution. Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) is ready to enter the pitch as Shandon Baptiste walks off.
65' Dangerous play by Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd). Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul.

60' An unsuccessful long-range effort by Anis Slimane (Sheffield Utd) after he collected a pass and unleashed a daisy-cutter. The ball was directed into the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper made an easy save.
57' The ball goes out of play. Sheffield Utd are awarded a corner kick.
56' Anis Slimane (Sheffield Utd) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range towards the middle of the goal, but Mark Flekken was alert and made an amazing save!
53' It is time for a substitution. Anis Slimane (Sheffield Utd) is on for William Osula.
52' Ethan Pinnock (Brentford) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
51' Stuart Attwell shows a yellow card to William Osula (Sheffield Utd) for his blatant foul.
51' Wesley Foderingham pulls off a great save to deny Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the right side of the goal.
50' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sheffield Utd.
48' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
48' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) makes a rough challenge and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul. Sheffield Utd earn a free kick.
46' Thomas Frank makes a switch. Yegor Yarmolyuk is coming on in place of Frank Onyeka (Brentford) at the start of the second period.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Christian Norgaard (Brentford) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
45+1' 1 - 0 Goal! Gustavo Hamer plays a short, square pass into the path of James McAtee (Sheffield Utd), who bends a shot straight into the top left corner to make it 1:0. Fabulous goal!
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Saman Ghoddos (Brentford) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
45' Neal Maupay (Brentford) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and Brentford manage to earn a corner.
43' The ball spins up and hits the hand of James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
41' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies miles wide of the left post.
40' A crossfield pass from Jack Robinson (Sheffield Utd) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
37' Gustavo Hamer links up with William Osula (Sheffield Utd), who fires just wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
37' Frank Onyeka (Brentford) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
36' Frank Onyeka (Brentford) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Wesley Foderingham was alert and made a comfortable save.
34' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) sees the run of William Osula and tries to slip the ball to him, but Mark Flekken sees the danger and gathers.
33' Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
31' A VAR review has confirmed it's nothing more than a yellow card for Frank Onyeka (Brentford).
30' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Frank Onyeka (Brentford)! Let's see what he decides.
30' Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
29' Frank Onyeka (Brentford) has tested the patience of referee Stuart Attwell and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
28' 1:0 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The number of shots on goal at present is 0:0.
27' PENALTY APPEAL after Ethan Pinnock (Brentford) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
27' The corner from Saman Ghoddos (Brentford) is cleared away by the defence.
26' Neal Maupay (Brentford) plays a one-two with Vitaly Janelt, but the move breaks down. Brentford will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
22' Neal Maupay (Brentford) commits a foul and Stuart Attwell immediately signals a free kick.
21' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) sends a long cross over to Yoane Wissa, but Wesley Foderingham comes forward to gather the ball.
19' Saman Ghoddos (Brentford) sends a long cross over to Keane Lewis-Potter, but Wesley Foderingham comes forward to gather the ball.
17' Auston Trusty (Sheffield Utd) takes out his opponent with a horrific tackle and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
14' Saman Ghoddos (Brentford) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
13' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) trips an opposition player and Stuart Attwell signals a foul. Brentford have a free kick.
10' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!

8' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick in order to find one of his teammates. His poor effort, however, sails way out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
7' Poor challenge! Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) is penalised for tripping and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle.
5' Sheffield Utd are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
2' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.

2' Auston Trusty (Sheffield Utd) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play. Sheffield Utd win a corner kick.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Brentford will have the kick-off.
Stuart Attwell is the one to supervise the game today.
